verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ כָּל־ שִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנְנ֛וּ עַצְמְךָ֥ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- dā·wiḏ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh way·yō·mə·rū lê·mōr hin·nū ‘aṣ·mə·ḵā ū·ḇə·śā·rə·ḵā ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said . . . Here we are your own flesh and blood
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO todas as tribos de Israel vieram a Davi, em Hebrom, e falaram, dizendo: Eis-nos aqui, somos teus ossos e tua carne.

verses.original: גַּם־ אֶתְמ֣וֹל גַּם־ שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם בִּהְי֨וֹת שָׁא֥וּל מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֗ה הָיִיתָה מוֹצִיא וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְנָגִ֖יד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’eṯ·mō·wl gam- šil·šō·wm bih·yō·wṯ šā·’ūl me·leḵ ‘ā·lê·nū ’at·tāh hå̄·yī·ṯå̄h mō·ṣī wə·ham·mē·ḇī ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer Yah·weh lə·ḵā ’at·tāh ṯir·‘eh ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh lə·nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Even . . . . . . in times past while Saul was king over us you were the one who led Israel out . . . and brought them back And to you the LORD said You will shepherd My people Israel and you will be ruler over them
verses.literalPt: E também outrora, sendo Saul ainda rei sobre nós, eras tu o que saías e entravas com Israel; e também o SENHOR te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo de Israel, e tu serás príncipe sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת לָהֶם֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֥ד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֧וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh way·yiḵ·rōṯ lā·hem ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ bə·rîṯ bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yim·šə·ḥū ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron where King David made with them a covenant before the LORD And they anointed him king over Israel
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, todos os anciãos de Israel vieram ao rei, em Hebrom; e o rei Davi fez com eles acordo em Hebrom, perante o SENHOR; e ungiram a Davi rei sobre Israel.

verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה דָּוִ֖ד בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה מָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh dā·wiḏ bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh mā·lāḵ
verses.literal: David was thirty years old . . . when he became king and he reigned forty years
verses.literalPt: Da idade de trinta anos era Davi quando começou a reinar; quarenta anos reinou.

verses.original: בְּחֶבְרוֹן֙ מָלַ֣ךְ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם מָלַ֗ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn mā·laḵ ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm wə·šiš·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim mā·laḵ šə·lō·šîm wə·šā·lōš šā·nāh ‘al kāl- yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three . . . years over all Israel and Judah
verses.literalPt: Em Hebrom reinou sobre Judá sete anos e seis meses, e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos sobre todo o Israel e Judá.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁיו֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל־ הַיְבֻסִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְדָוִ֤ד לֵאמֹר֙ לֹא־ תָב֣וֹא הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֣י אִם־ הֱסִֽירְךָ֗ הַעִוְרִ֤ים וְהַפִּסְחִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ יָב֥וֹא דָוִ֖ד הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ham·me·leḵ wa·’ă·nā·šāw yə·rū·šā·lim ’el- hay·ḇu·sî yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·mer lə·ḏā·wiḏ lê·mōr lō- ṯā·ḇō·w hên·nāh kî ’im- hĕ·sî·rə·ḵā ha·‘iw·rîm wə·hap·pis·ḥîm lê·mōr lō- yā·ḇō·w ḏā·wiḏ hên·nāh
verses.literal: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land The Jebusites said to David You will never get in here Even . . . the blind and lame . . . can repel you For they thought David cannot get in here
verses.literalPt: E partiu o rei com os seus homens a Jerusalém, contra os jebuseus que habitavam naquela terra; e falaram a Davi, dizendo: Não entrarás aqui, pois os cegos e os coxos te repelirão, querendo dizer: Não entrará Davi aqui.

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֣ד דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kōḏ dā·wiḏ ’êṯ mə·ṣu·ḏaṯ ṣî·yō·wn hî ‘îr dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Nevertheless , David captured the fortress of Zion that is the City of David
verses.literalPt: Porém Davi tomou a fortaleza de Sião; esta é a cidade de Davi.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא כָּל־ מַכֵּ֤ה יְבֻסִי֙ וְיִגַּ֣ע בַּצִּנּ֔וֹר וְאֶת־ הַפִּסְחִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַ֣עִוְרִ֔ים שָׂנְאוּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ דָּוִ֑ד עַל־ כֵּן֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ עִוֵּ֣ר וּפִסֵּ֔חַ לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ bay·yō·wm ha·hū kāl- mak·kêh yə·ḇu·sî wə·yig·ga‘ baṣ·ṣin·nō·wr wə·’eṯ- hap·pis·ḥîm wə·’eṯ- ha·‘iw·rîm śå̄·nə·ʾū ne·p̄eš dā·wiḏ ‘al- kên yō·mə·rū ‘iw·wêr ū·p̄is·sê·aḥ lō yā·ḇō·w ’el- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: On that . . . day he said Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised . . . by David That is why . . . it is said The blind and the lame will never enter . . . the palace
verses.literalPt: Porque Davi disse naquele dia: Qualquer que ferir aos jebuseus, suba ao canal e fira aos coxos e aos cegos, a quem a alma de Davi odeia. Por isso se diz: Nem cego nem coxo entrará nesta casa.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב דָּוִד֙ בַּמְּצֻדָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָא־ לָ֖הּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּ֤בֶן דָּוִד֙ סָבִ֔יב מִן־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וָבָֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ dā·wiḏ bam·mə·ṣu·ḏāh way·yiq·rā- lāh ‘îr dā·wiḏ way·yi·ḇen dā·wiḏ sā·ḇîḇ min- ham·mil·lō·w wā·ḇā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: So David took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David He built it up all the way around from the supporting terraces inward
verses.literalPt: Assim habitou Davi na fortaleza, e a chamou a cidade de Davi; e Davi foi edificando em redor, desde Milo para dentro.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: And David became greater and greater for the LORD God of Hosts was with him
verses.literalPt: E Davi ia, cada vez mais, aumentando e crescendo, porque o SENHOR Deus dos Exércitos era com ele.

verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל־ דָּוִד֒ וַעֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֣י עֵ֔ץ וְחָֽרָשֵׁ֖י אֶ֣בֶן קִ֑יר וַיִּבְנֽוּ־ בַ֖יִת לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥî·rām me·leḵ- ṣōr mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- dā·wiḏ wa·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm wə·ḥā·rā·šê ‘êṣ wə·ḥā·rā·šê ’e·ḇen qîr way·yiḇ·nū- ḇa·yiṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David along with cedar logs carpenters . . . and stonemasons . . . . . . and they built a palace for David
verses.literalPt: E Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou mensageiros a Davi, e madeira de cedro, e carpinteiros, e pedreiros que edificaram a Davi uma casa.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔ד כִּֽי־ הֱכִינ֧וֹ יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכִי֙ נִשֵּׂ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ dā·wiḏ kî- hĕ·ḵî·nōw Yah·weh lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḵî niś·śê mam·laḵ·tōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr ‘am·mōw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel . . . and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel
verses.literalPt: E entendeu Davi que o SENHOR o confirmara rei sobre Israel, e que exaltara o seu reino por amor do seu povo.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ דָּוִ֨ד ע֜וֹד פִּֽלַגְשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י בֹּא֣וֹ מֵחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיִּוָּ֥לְדּוּ ע֛וֹד לְדָוִ֖ד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wiḏ ‘ō·wḏ pi·laḡ·šîm wə·nā·šîm mî·rū·šā·lim ’a·ḥă·rê bō·’ōw mê·ḥeḇ·rō·wn way·yiw·wå̄·lə·dū ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḏā·wiḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: After he had arrived from Hebron David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem and more sons and daughters were born to him
verses.literalPt: E tomou Davi mais concubinas e mulheres de Jerusalém, depois que viera de Hebrom; e nasceram a Davi mais filhos e filhas.

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמ֛וֹת הַיִּלֹּדִ֥ים ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשׁוֹבָ֔ב וְנָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hay·yil·lō·ḏîm lōw bî·rū·šā·lim šam·mū·a‘ wə·šō·w·ḇāḇ wə·nā·ṯān ū·šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem Shammua Shobab Nathan Solomon
verses.literalPt: E estes são os nomes dos que lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Samua, e Sobabe, e Natã, e Salomão,

verses.original: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְנֶ֥פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḇ·ḥār we·’ĕ·lî·šū·a‘ wə·ne·p̄eḡ wə·yā·p̄î·a‘
verses.literal: Ibhar Elishua Nepheg Japhia
verses.literalPt: E Ibar, e Elisua, e Nefegue, e Jafia,

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃פ
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ wə·’el·yā·ḏā‘ we·’ĕ·lî·p̄ā·leṭ
verses.literal: Elishama Eliada and Eliphelet
verses.literalPt: E Elisama, e Eliada, e Elifelete.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי־ מָשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֤ד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ כָל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֖רֶד אֶל־ הַמְּצוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū p̄ə·liš·tîm kî- mā·šə·ḥū ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·lū ḵāl pə·liš·tîm lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yiš·ma‘ dā·wiḏ way·yê·reḏ ’el- ham·mə·ṣū·ḏāh
verses.literal: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel they all went in search of him but David learned of this and went down to the stronghold
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, os filisteus que haviam ungido a Davi rei sobre Israel, todos os filisteus subiram em busca de Davi; o que ouvindo Davi, desceu à fortaleza.

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁ֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm bā·’ū way·yin·nā·ṭə·šū bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim
verses.literalPt: E os filisteus vieram, e se estenderam pelo vale de Refaim.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤ד בַּֽיהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶֽעֱלֶה֙ אֶל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הֲתִתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדִ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ עֲלֵ֔ה כִּֽי־ נָתֹ֥ן אֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al dā·wiḏ Yah·weh lê·mōr ha·’e·‘ĕ·leh ’el- pə·liš·tîm hă·ṯit·tə·nêm bə·yā·ḏî way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- dā·wiḏ ‘ă·lêh kî- nā·ṯōn ’et·tên ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tîm bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: So David inquired of the LORD Should I go up against the Philistines Will You deliver them into my hand Go up replied the LORD - for I will surely deliver . . . the Philistines into your hand
verses.literalPt: E Davi consultou ao SENHOR, dizendo: Subirei contra os filisteus? Entregar-mos-ás nas minhas mãos? E disse o SENHOR a Davi: Sobe, porque certamente entregarei os filisteus nas tuas mãos.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א דָוִ֥ד בְּבַֽעַל־ פְּרָצִים֮ וַיַּכֵּ֣ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִד֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ אֹיְבַ֛י לְפָנַ֖י כְּפֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḇa·‘al- pə·rā·ṣîm way·yak·kêm šām dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer pā·raṣ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇay lə·p̄ā·nay kə·p̄e·reṣ mā·yim ‘al- kên qā·rā šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū ba·‘al pə·rā·ṣîm
verses.literal: So David went to Baal-perazim where he defeated the Philistines . . . . . . and said Like a bursting flood the LORD has burst out against my enemies before me So . . . he called . . . that place Baal-perazim
verses.literalPt: Então foi Davi a Baal-Perazim; e feriu-os ali Davi, e disse: Rompeu o SENHOR a meus inimigos diante de mim, como quem rompe águas. Por isso chamou o nome daquele lugar Baal-Perazim.

verses.original: וַיַּעַזְבוּ־ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׂאֵ֥ם דָּוִ֖ד וַאֲנָשָֽׁיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘az·ḇū- šām ’eṯ- ‘ă·ṣab·bê·hem way·yiś·śā·’êm dā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šāw
verses.literal: There the Philistines abandoned their idols and David and his men carried them away
verses.literalPt: E deixaram ali os seus ídolos; e Davi e os seus homens os tomaram.

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֥פוּ ע֛וֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לַֽעֲל֑וֹת וַיִּנָּֽטְשׁ֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ pə·liš·tîm la·‘ă·lō·wṯ way·yin·nā·ṭə·šū bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Once again . . . the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim
verses.literalPt: E os filisteus tornaram a subir, e se estenderam pelo vale de Refaim.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל דָּוִד֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲלֶ֑ה הָסֵב֙ אֶל־ אַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם וּבָ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם מִמּ֥וּל בְּכָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al dā·wiḏ Yah·weh way·yō·mer lō ṯa·‘ă·leh hā·sêḇ ’el- ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ū·ḇā·ṯā lā·hem mim·mūl bə·ḵā·’îm
verses.literal: So David inquired of the LORD who answered Do not march straight up but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees
verses.literalPt: E Davi consultou ao SENHOR, o qual disse: Não subirás; mas rodeia por detrás deles, e virás a eles por defronte das amoreiras.

verses.original: וִ֠יהִי בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ אֶת־ ק֧וֹל צְעָדָ֛ה בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַבְּכָאִ֖ים אָ֣ז תֶּחֱרָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אָ֗ז יָצָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לְהַכּ֖וֹת בְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî bə·šå̄·mə·ʿă·ḵå̄ ’eṯ- qō·wl ṣə·‘ā·ḏāh bə·rā·šê hab·bə·ḵā·’îm ’āz te·ḥĕ·rāṣ kî ’āz yā·ṣā Yah·weh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā lə·hak·kō·wṯ bə·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees move quickly because this will mean that . . . the LORD has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que, ouvindo tu um estrondo de marcha pelas copas das amoreiras, então te apressarás; porque o SENHOR saiu então diante de ti, a ferir o arraial dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ דָּוִד֙ כֵּ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִגֶּ֖בַע עַד־ בֹּאֲךָ֥ גָֽזֶר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś dā·wiḏ kên ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·hū Yah·weh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm mig·ge·ḇa‘ ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵā ḡā·zer
verses.literal: So David . . . did as the LORD had commanded him and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to . . . Gezer
verses.literalPt: E fez Davi assim como o SENHOR lhe tinha ordenado; e feriu os filisteus desde Gibeá, até chegar a Gezer.
